headline: Mexico reforms foreign investment law to screen AI, chip, and energy M&A
summary: Mexico published reforms to its Foreign Investment Law granting the government power to review and block foreign acquisitions in strategic sectors, including artificial intelligence, semiconductors, biotechnology, and energy.
why: Mexico is a primary destination for nearshoring industrial capital, making any heightened investment screening mechanism critical for cross-border mergers and acquisitions.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: New statutory powers to block inbound acquisitions create regulatory hurdles for foreign tech and energy capital.
